method: Discovery layer only. Counts locate documents to read.

themes.label: Unclear requirements
themes.query: "unclear" OR "ambiguous" OR "ambiguity" OR "further clarity" OR "additional clarity" OR "clarification is" OR "we would welcome clarity"

themes.label: Outsourcing and third parties
themes.query: "outsourcing" OR "outsourced" OR "third party" OR "third-party" OR "intragroup" OR "intra-group"

themes.label: Cost and disproportionality
themes.query: "disproportionate" OR "disproportionately" OR "cost of compliance" OR "compliance burden" OR "administrative burden" OR "resource intensive" OR "resource-intensive" OR "significant cost"

themes.label: Proportionality and smaller firms
themes.query: "proportionality" OR "proportionate" OR "smaller firms" OR "smaller entities" OR "small firms" OR "one size fits all" OR "one-size-fits-all"

themes.label: Implementation timelines
themes.query: "implementation period" OR "lead time" OR "lead-in" OR "insufficient time" OR "not feasible" OR "transitional period" OR "sufficient time"

themes.label: Authorisation and approval friction
themes.query: "authorisation process" OR "approval process" OR "application process" OR "delays" OR "timeframes"

themes.label: Duplicated effort and re-reporting
themes.query: "duplication" OR "duplicative" OR "already provided" OR "already reported" OR "same information" OR "multiple returns" OR "re-submit" OR "resubmit"

themes.label: Individual approval and vetting
themes.query: "fitness and probity" OR "pre-approval" OR "PCF" OR "controlled function"

themes.label: Definitions and inconsistency
themes.query: "definition" AND (unclear OR inconsistent OR differs OR differ OR aligned OR alignment)

themes.label: Regulatory reporting mechanics
themes.query: (reporting OR "returns" OR "return") AND (burden OR frequency OR template OR templates OR taxonomy OR XBRL)

themes.label: Credit union operating constraints
themes.query: "credit union" OR "credit unions" OR "common bond" OR "CUSO"

themes.label: Customer disclosure mechanics
themes.query: "disclosure requirements" OR "customer communication" OR "information overload" OR "warning statement"

themes.label: Safeguarding client money
themes.query: "safeguarding" OR "client money" OR "client assets" OR "segregation of funds" OR "safeguarded funds"

themes.label: IT and system change
themes.query: "system changes" OR "systems changes" OR "IT systems" OR "legacy system" OR "legacy systems" OR "system build" OR "system development" OR "technology investment"

themes.label: Switching and portability mechanics
themes.query: "switching" OR "switch" OR "portability" OR "account transfer"

themes.label: Fraud and scam handling
themes.query: fraud OR scam OR scams OR "authorised push payment" OR "money mule" OR impersonation

themes.label: Manual work and spreadsheets
themes.query: "manual" OR "manually" OR "spreadsheet" OR "spreadsheets" OR "re-key" OR "rekey" OR "paper-based"

themes.label: Vulnerable customers in practice
themes.query: "vulnerable customer" OR "vulnerable customers" OR "vulnerability" OR "in vulnerable circumstances"

themes.label: Data quality and reconciliation
themes.query: "data quality" OR "data governance" OR "reconciliation" OR "reconcile" OR "data integrity"

themes.label: Complaints handling operations
themes.query: "complaints handling" OR "complaint handling" OR "root cause" OR "root-cause" OR "complaints process"
